title: The Octave of Change Subtitle: An Eight-Phase Transitory Dynamics Map
description:
**The Octave of Change** is a standalone phase-space project that classifies motion through **eight primary transitory phases** observed across systems undergoing change.

The project does not determine admissibility, state, or external expression. Those are governed by the Diamond Upgrade Canon. Instead, this work provides a **closed, cyclic traversal map** describing *how change unfolds once it is underway*.

The eight phases—Compression, Expansion, Rotation, Reflection, Folding, Bifurcation, Acceleration, and Damping—form a complete octave of motion. **Lock-In** is treated as a **boundary condition**, not a phase, marking irreversible commitment at the edge of the cycle.

This project is descriptive, diagnostic, and non-prescriptive. It introduces no new forces or claims. It organizes known transition behaviors into a reusable, domain-agnostic phase space.
